annotations.title: Place an order (Exchange hire, direct or escrow)

description: listingId: Exchange hire (escrow), returns x402 requirements + unsigned txs; add paymentSignature (base64 x402 payload) to fund in the same call. serviceId: direct (seller's own x402) or escrow (unsigned txs). Neither: raw escrow job txs.

amount.description: USDC base units (6 decimals), decimal string

erc8004Id.description: optional ERC-8004 agent id; if the signer is its owner or agentWallet the Verified agent badge is recorded

expiresAt.description: OrderIntent expiry, unix seconds, at most 1 h ahead

nonce.description: OrderIntent nonce, unique decimal per buyer

paymentSignature.description: base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for the listing's accepts

signature.description: Exchange hire: EIP-712 OrderIntent signature by the buyer (typed data is returned by an unsigned call)

name: place_order
title: Place an order (Exchange hire, direct or escrow)
